description: Enhance your Minecraft advancements experience with a revamped UI that utilizes more of your screen space, especially at higher GUI scales.  This mod is a continuation of the original AdvancementInfo mod by gbl marked as end-of-life since Jun 2024.

mods.name: Advancements Reloaded
mods.description: Make it easier to see which advancements you have and what's missing.
